label: Third-factor union bound without independence
meaning: For any measure on cases and verdicts of any type, a selection error at most e1 and a factor/truth gap at most e2 on the same distribution give a judgment/truth error at most e1 + e2, hence agreement at least 1 − e1 − e2 for a probability measure. No independence between the two errors is assumed. Analyst quantification of the correlation Enoch's third-factor reply proposes to explain; both rates are open inputs, and nothing is derived about their values, any single case, another distribution or another verdict type.
